# GTA Drywall & Carpentry

> GTA Drywall & Carpentry is a union drywall and carpentry contractor serving Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area, on commercial and residential projects.

Services: drywall installation, taping and finishing, steel stud and wood framing, and finish carpentry and trim.

Service area: Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Milton, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Newmarket, Aurora, Caledon.

Contact: 647-449-0694, info@gtadrywallandcarpentry.com. There is no contact form; call or email.
